preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
The first element of the arithmetic progression A1 must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The common difference D must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.
The indices L and R must be valid, with L less than or equal to R, and R must not exceed 1,000,000,000,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(F(A[i]) for i in range(L, R + 1)))
postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of F(A[i]) for all i from L to R, formatted as a single integer.
